propositions: Dependabot PR #131 proposes updating five packages (botocore, genai-prices, json-repair, mypy, ruff) but cannot merge to main because the repository uses Gerrit for all changes, requiring re-authoring as a Gerrit change.

New mypy and ruff versions must be tested to ensure they do not surface new findings that require code fixes, and any new findings discovered must be fixed in source code rather than suppressed with noqa or type-ignore comments.

The complexity baseline (scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py) is shrink-only and must not increase; if a newer ruff scores functions differently, the baseline file must not be edited to accommodate the change.
The upgrade must be verified by running make lint, make typecheck, and the full test suite to confirm all gates pass under the new tool versions before landing.
